register.reg_condition: when FEAT_AMUv1 is implemented and FEAT_AA32 is implemented

purpose_text.para: Global user enable register for the activity monitors. Enables or disables EL0 access to the activity monitors. AMUSERENR is applicable to both the architected and the auxiliary counter groups.

field_description.para: Traps EL0 accesses to the activity monitors registers to EL1.

listitem.content: AMUSERENR can always be read at EL0 and is not governed by this bit.

field_value_description.para: EL0 accesses to the activity monitors registers are trapped to EL1.
This control does not cause any instructions to be trapped. Software can access all activity monitor registers at EL0.
